Gemini 3.8 Flash

The gods, having slain the Asuras and fleeing from blood-money, confused the seasons, the year.
The gods sought its ordering.
They ordered it by means of the seasonal cups.
That the seasonal cups are drawn

S. here has the words इति आयुस्थानकं दशमं (sic) प्रपाठकः समाप्तः॥१॥ After the conclusion of 44, 9 stands clearly इति कपिष्ठलसंहितायां चतुश्चत्वारिंशतमो ध्यायः॥ Here, however, the section following thereupon is evidently counted as the tenth to the preceding nine, while the numeral ॥१॥, in contradiction thereto, clearly characterizes it as the first section of chapter 45, thus 45, 1. It appears, then, that an older numbering crosses here with a younger one, in an unreconciled manner. The most interesting point therein, however, is that the older reckoning agrees with the Kāṭhaka, in which this section indeed clearly belongs as tenth to the nine preceding ones.)
